method: Bounded public-web review of the established Rybar, Dva Majors, RVvoenkor, and Colonelcassad Telegram previews, supplemented by exact-date domain searches. No authentication, platform API, access-control bypass, inferred sequential identifier, map capture, media download, or precise operational-location retention was used.

sources_checked.result: The public preview exposed canonical post 82240, explicitly headed as the chronicle for 5 August 2026 and displayed at 19:49. Telegram did not expose a timezone-bearing datetime, so the item is retained with day precision and uncertain exact UTC inclusion.

Visible in-day posts were out of topic, fundraising, detailed infrastructure reporting, operational travel-warning relays, launch or strike media, or pure relays of official statements. None was admitted.

Visible posts focused on individual strikes, vessels, named commercial and infrastructure damage, and relayed claims already represented by official or strike-focused shards. Granular and overlapping items were not admitted.

Visible posts included broad relays, animated strike geometry, impact video, and tactical or equipment footage. Broad relays were duplicate or low-information lineage, while visual and tactical material was excluded.

included_items.short_excerpt_original: Хроника специальной военной операции. За 5 августа 2026 года
included_items.summary: Rybar published a daily digest aggregating claims about strikes and operations. Only the dated digest identity and broad aggregation role were retained; named targets, locality-level frontline claims, map links, and media were omitted.
included_items.publication_time_basis: The heading explicitly states 5 August 2026 and the public preview displayed 19:49, but no timezone-bearing datetime was exposed.
included_items.lineage_note: Aggregator publication with multiple linked and unnamed upstreams. No individual claim was extracted and no upstream item was promoted through this discovery task.

excluded_candidates.reason: The video digest substantially overlaps the later dated daily chronicle and points to external video; it was not duplicated as a separate source item.
The city-day greeting was outside the task topics of operations and claims.

excluded_candidates.source: Dva Majors posts on infrastructure, route radio frequencies, launches, and strike media
excluded_candidates.reason: The posts contained vulnerable-facility, travel-route, deployment-support, launch, or targeting-adjacent detail and were withheld under the safety exclusion.

excluded_candidates.source: RVvoenkor posts on individual vessel and infrastructure strikes
excluded_candidates.reason: The visible posts contained granular impact and named-target detail and overlapped official or strike-focused shards.

excluded_candidates.source: Colonelcassad Telegram message 221058 and adjacent visible posts
excluded_candidates.reason: The broad relay duplicated strike aftermath lineage, while adjacent animated strike schemes, impact footage, and tactical media were excluded for provenance and safety reasons.
Already represented by canonical URLs in the earlier 00:00–05:00 UTC campaign and not duplicated.

access_failures.detail: Public previews displayed clock times but not timezone-bearing datetime metadata, so exact UTC inclusion for message 82240 remains unresolved.
Public previews are rolling windows and do not guarantee exhaustive recovery of every in-window post or complete edit history.
The retained digest aggregates multiple linked and unnamed reports; no complete set of stable upstream canonical item URLs was established in this shard.

artifact_capture.reason: No media, page bytes, maps, video, or other immutable artifacts were downloaded, hashed, or stored.

coverage_gaps: The one admitted record has day precision; exact inclusion after the 05:00 UTC boundary remains uncertain because Telegram did not expose timezone-bearing metadata.
The bounded four-channel scan is not exhaustive across Russian milblogger publishing.
Rolling Telegram previews may omit posts, edits, deletions, and original publication metadata.
The retained digest aggregates multiple upstream reports whose complete canonical lineage was not resolved.
Granular frontline claims, named vulnerable facilities, movement and route detail, strike geometry, maps, and attached media were intentionally excluded.
No milblogger assertion was independently assessed or converted into a claim, observation, territorial conclusion, or report narrative.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, active-unit locations, target coordinates, vulnerable-facility details, or map geometry were persisted.
No authenticated platform data, private material, or access-control bypass was used.
The record preserves uncertainty and aggregation lineage rather than treating the digest as verified fact.
